verdict.rationale: Jules runs code changes in an isolated VM and generates diffs/PRs for review, and one community report notes it is 'good at making tests for very specific/isolated functions,' implying some test generation capability, but there is no first-party documentation describing an explicit test-generate-and-run validation loop before proposing changes. missing for 10: official docs on automated test generation/execution as a validation step, evidence of test results being surfaced to users before PR creation, and independent confirmation across varied codebases.
